ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.passage:

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by <u>ⓑ utilizing</u> Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with <u>ⓒ less</u> soldiers. <u>ⓓ Living</u> in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 원문: with fewer soldiers. soldiers는 가산명사이므로 less가 아니라 fewer가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ⓒ less → fewer: 가산명사 복수형(soldiers) 앞에는 fewer 사용
✅ ⓐ known: 과거분사로 fortress를 수식, 적절
✅ ⓑ utilizing: by + V-ing 구문, 적절
✅ ⓓ Living: 동명사 주어, 적절
det.tip: fewer + 가산명사 복수(fewer soldiers), less + 불가산명사(less water). 자주 출제되는 어법 포인트입니다.

questions.passage: Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by (A) [utilizing / utilized] Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Surrounded by low walls, the area (B) [housed / was housed] administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that (C) [combining / combined] the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong.
questions.stem: 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: (A) 전치사 by 뒤 동명사 / (B) house는 타동사로 능동 / (C) 관계대명사절의 동사 과거형
det.analysis:
✅ ① utilizing - housed - combined: by+V-ing, house(수용하다)는 능동, that절의 동사 과거형
❌ utilized: by 뒤 동명사 필요
❌ was housed: house는 여기서 '수용하다'의 능동 의미
❌ combining: 관계대명사절의 술어동사이므로 과거형
det.tip: house는 명사(집)뿐 아니라 동사(수용하다)로도 쓰입니다. The area housed ~ = '그 지역에는 ~이 있었다'.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 원문: a new type of fortress emerged that combined. 선행사(a new type of fortress)가 있으므로 what이 아니라 that(관계대명사)이 적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ⓓ what → that: 선행사가 있으므로 관계대명사 that/which 사용
✅ ⓐ unnoticed: go + p.p. 구문, 적절
✅ ⓑ Surrounded: 수동 분사구문, 적절

det.tip: what vs. that: 선행사가 있으면 that/which, 선행사가 없으면 what을 사용합니다.

questions.stem: 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: (A) 산지 지형을 유리하게 / (B) 실용적이지 않았다 (not practical) / (C) 두 양식의 장점을 결합
det.analysis:
✅ ② advantage - practical - strengths: 방어에 유리하게 활용, not practical(비실용적), 장점 결합
❌ disadvantage: 이점으로 활용한 것
❌ impractical: not practical이 원문 (not impractical은 이중부정)
❌ weaknesses: 약점이 아닌 장점을 결합
det.tip: to one's advantage = '유리하게'. not practical ≠ not impractical — 이중부정에 주의하세요.

questions.passage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes ① <u>unnoticed</u>. This fortress artfully ② <u>blends</u> two distinct Korean styles.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against ③ <u>defenders</u> by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 원문: the final defense against invaders. 방어 대상은 '침략자'이지 '방어자'가 아니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ defenders(방어자) → 원문은 invaders(침략자). 침략자에 대한 방어
✅ ① unnoticed(간과되는): 적절
✅ ② blends(융합하다): 적절
✅ ④ displayed(보여주었다): 적절
det.tip: invaders(침략자) ↔ defenders(방어자). defend(방어하다) vs. invade(침략하다)를 구별하세요.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 산성의 핵심 전략적 이점은 높은 지대를 이용하여 적은 병력으로 적을 효과적으로 방어하는 것이다.

❌ ① house large populations within its walls: 거주 기능은 오히려 약점

det.korean: 읍성은 평시에 행정과 일상 활동의 중심지로 기능했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ a center for administration and daily activities: 행정 건물, 학습 시설, 훈련장, 농민 거주

❌ ② an isolated military stronghold: 읍성은 군사 요새가 아닌 생활 중심지
❌ ④ a temporary shelter during natural disasters: 자연재해 관련 언급 없음

det.korean: 화성 이전에는 평시(읍성)와 전시(산성)에 따라 거주지를 오가야 했다.

questions.passage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "its uniqueness often goes unnoticed"가 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 화성의 독특함이 간과된다 = 많은 사람들이 화성의 진정한 가치(두 양식의 융합)를 모른다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 대부분의 사람들이 화성이 두 양식을 결합한 특별한 성곽임을 인식하지 못한다: 독특함이 간과된다는 의미

❌ ④ 화성이 관광 명소로서의 가치가 없다: 그런 의미가 아님
det.tip: goes unnoticed = '간과되다'. 화성이 유네스코 유산이라는 사실은 알려져 있지만, 그 독특함(두 양식 융합)은 잘 알려지지 않았다는 뜻입니다.
